Quest.Title: Ring of Evolution
Quest.Script: This is an emergency. I am "Terry" of EVE Headquarters. You are ordered to return to guild headquarters at once. A special mission has been handed down to you. I cannot give you the details, but please return as soon as possible. What is your situation? Can you make it?

Complete.Script: Listen carefully to what I am about to tell you. These are orders from above, and I do not know the details myself. This is a top-secret mission and must never be leaked. Do you understand?

Take this. All you have to do is deliver it. It sounds easy, but the problem is that this document must go to the vampire Rebecca inside Limbo Castle. Of course, arrangements have been made so that you can get into the vampires' castle, so don't worry too much. Since this mission must be carried out in secret, Motorcycles and Helicopters are forbidden. Please keep that in mind.
Complete.SayNPC: Deliver the top-secret document to Rebecca inside Limbo Castle
Complete.Script: Thank you for coming all this way. Well? How does it feel for a lowly human to behold the beautiful Limbo Castle...
I have received what you brought. Now take this with you. Farewell, then... Though perhaps we shall meet again. Ho ho ho ho ho ho ho ho...
Complete.SayNPC: Deliver the reply to Terry in Eslania Northwest
Complete.Script: You made it back safely. What a relief. A new mission may come your way soon. Please stay somewhere close by.

Quest.FailMessage: Oh dear. You failed. How disappoiiinting.

Fail.Killed: Do not die during the mission

Quest.Title: Gate of the Altar
Quest.Script: This is "Terry" of EVE Headquarters. Command was greatly impressed by your work on the last mission, and an important new mission has been handed down in a hurry. We hear that an entrance has opened in the upper central part of Adam's Holy Land, leading into the heart of the Holy Land. Please investigate it at once. Can you do it?

Complete.EnterDynamicZone: Head for the "Gate of the Altar" in the center of "Adam's Holy Land"
Complete.ClearDynamicZone: Complete the "Magic Circle" with monster blood in time and find the way inside
Complete.Script: Kzzt... The signal is bad. According to... the information we just... received... Kzzt-. At the Gate of the Altar there are magic circles... six of... Kzzt, kz-kzzt, kz-.
Complete.EnterDynamicZone: Enter the Altar of Blood through the magic circle
Complete.Script: Fall. 'When the magic circle activated, we fell endlessly into a deep, dark abyss.'
Hell. 'The corpses of countless humans and vampires were heaped into mountains, and the rank smell of sloshing blood stung our noses.'
Sacrifice. 'Our comrades, their souls held captive, stare at us in reproach amid the eerie laughter of fiends.'
Betrayal. 'Was this mission only a trap to offer us up as sacrifices? Then that letter back then... so the leaders of both sides could join hands...'
Doubt. 'What on earth are all these sacrifices for?'
Complete.ClearDynamicZone: Kill monsters to obtain "Life Spirals" and use them to rescue the Slayers

Quest.FailMessage: Oh dear. You failed. How disappoiiinting.

Fail.Killed: Do not die during the mission

Quest.Title: Abraxas, the Flutter of a Small Bird's Wings
Quest.Script: Go to "Terry". Terry is in "Eslania Northwest".

Complete.Script: 'To think the so-called leaders of EVE would plot something like this... They are no better than bloodsuckers. I cannot forgive them.'
You completed the mission safely. Thank good...
What? That's... No... I had nothing to do with...
Calm down. Look, it's...
Complete.ClearDynamicZone: Guard the "Sealing of Reason" within your own mind and survive for "10 minutes"

Quest.FailMessage: Oh dear. You failed. How disappoiiinting.

Quest.Title: Ring of Evolution
Quest.Script: Where on earth have you been? I sent you telepathy I don't know how many times, and you only answer now... Honestly... What? Don't tell me you've already forgotten my voice? It's me, Seth... Seth of Limbo Castle. When you were a greenhorn I gave you all the good rings and necklaces, and this is how you treat me? Oh, listen to me ramble. Anyway, come see me right away. The Master has an important mission for you. You can come, right? And if you've picked up anything nice, bring it along...

Complete.Script: Oh... You're here, you're here. Long time no see. How've you been, then... More importantly, the Master has given a special order. It has to be done in secret, so swear to keep it secret. What? As long as I keep quiet it'll be fine? Why, you...

Here, tuck this away safely. All you have to do is deliver it. Sounds easy, but guess who you have to give it to? Heh heh heh... None other than Kaiser, the leader of the Slayers. Don't ask me why it has to go to him, 'cause I don't know either.. Well, off you go. And don't try anything bold like biting Kaiser's neck. Heh heh heh heh... Oh, and don't do anything stupid like turning into a bat or opening a Seal during the mission.. Remember, you're on a secret mission..
Complete.SayNPC: Deliver the top-secret document to Kaiser in Eslania Northwest
Complete.Script: Hmph... Is this it? No funny business. Stay right where you are.
Hmm... Good. Take this. Watch yourself on the way back. And make sure you never run into me again, or your top half and bottom half may end up going separate ways.
Complete.SayNPC: Deliver the reply to Seth inside Limbo Castle
Complete.Script: Right... You're back, you're back. Hand that over. Nice work. The Master may give another order soon. Stay ready.

Fail.Killed: Do not die during the mission

Quest.Title: Gate of the Altar
Quest.Script: It's me, Seth. You hear me? Ho ho ho ho ho. Guess what? The Master was very pleased. Everyone's praising how well you carried out that order the other day. But listen, he's gone and handed down another new order in a hurry. You know Adam's Holy Land? An entrance has opened in its upper central part, leading into the heart of the Holy Land. You're going now, right?

Complete.EnterDynamicZone: Head for the "Gate of the Altar" in the center of "Adam's Holy Land"
Complete.ClearDynamicZone: Complete the "Magic Circle" with monster blood in time and find the way inside

Hell. 'The corpses of countless humans and vampires were heaped into mountains, and the rank smell of sloshing blood stung our noses.'
Sacrifice. 'The comrades who came in with us, their souls held captive, stare at us in reproach amid the eerie laughter of fiends.'
Betrayal. 'Was this mission only a trap to offer us up as sacrifices? Then that letter back then... so the leaders of both sides could join hands...'
Doubt. 'What on earth are all these sacrifices for?'

Quest.Script: Go to "Seth". Seth is "Inside Limbo Castle".

Complete.Script: 'So the so-called Masters who lead the Vampires would sell out the blood of their own kind... I cannot forgive them.'
Oh my, that must have been rough, huh? Look at your face, it's all...
What? That's... No, no... I had nothing to do with...
I said calm down... It's just that...

Quest.Title: Ring of Evolution
Quest.Script: I am Hora of the Ousters Village. I send you this message through the power of the spirits. Lady Lavinia says there is an urgent matter. Please return to the village quickly. I cannot tell you the details now. Let me say it once more: this is urgent. We truly need you. Will you come?

Complete.Script: You came. Thank you. May the pure heart and blessing of Elaim, the water spirit, be with you. An important secret mission awaits you.

Please take this. Your task is to carry it to someone. The one you must meet is the heretic vampire "Larva". Larva does not usually receive anyone, but if you go in spirit form bearing this token, Larva will agree to talk. I will borrow Elaim's power to cast a spell on you. In a moment your body and soul will separate. Do not worry about your body; I will keep it safe. Now, hurry to Larva. Oh, and in spirit form you cannot use magic, attack, or do many other things. But no attack can harm you either, so do not worry. May Elaim's blessing...
Complete.SayNPC: Deliver the top-secret document to Larva in Limbo Castle Southeast
Complete.Script: Who is this little soul that has sought me out in such a place? Ah, so it is Lavinia's...

Take this and go back. And one thing more... Strange things are happening between the vampires and the humans of late. That they would join hands is unthinkable, yet they are creatures full of nothing but greed... Mark my words, and be sure to pass them on to Lavinia.
Complete.SayNPC: Deliver the reply to Hora in the Ousters Village
Complete.Script: So this is it. Thank you for your trouble. I was very worried about you. What? Something like that between the humans and the vampires...? If Larva says so, it cannot be idle talk. I understand. I will tell Lady Lavinia. I will send you another message soon.

Quest.FailMessage: Oh no, you failed. What a pity.

Fail.Killed: Do not die during the mission
